summary:
台積電最新季度營收與每股盈餘雙雙優於市場預期，受惠於強勁的AI相關半導體需求。
• 每股盈餘達 4.31，超出市場預期的 3.89，驚喜幅度達 10.89%。
• 營收達到 12,703.8 億元，較去年同期顯著成長 36.05%。
• 受惠於高階運算與人工智慧晶片製造的強勁動能，毛利率保持高檔水準。
• 先進製程需求持續擴張，產能利用率維持高檔。
ai_view:
觀點：財報展現強勁的 AI 晶片代工優勢，營收與獲利超預期釋放正面訊號。短中期對股價具備支撐作用，評價面維持在 31.83 倍本益比。後續應持續追蹤先進製程產能擴充進度、毛利率走勢及主要客戶的 AI 資本支出變化。

需留意：全球總體經濟環境不確定性可能影響終端消費電子需求。；地緣政治風險與海外廠房擴張帶來的初期成本壓力。

summary_en:
TSM reported better-than-expected revenue and EPS, driven by robust AI-related semiconductor demand.
• EPS reached 4.31, beating the consensus estimate of 3.89 with a 10.89% surprise.
• Revenue came in at $1,270.38B, marking a robust 36.05% increase year-over-year.
• Benefited from strong momentum in high-performance computing and AI chip manufacturing.
• Advanced process nodes saw expanding demand, keeping capacity utilization high.

ai_view_en:
View: The earnings demonstrate robust AI foundry advantages with a beat on both top and bottom lines, signaling positive momentum. This supports near-to-mid-term share price performance amid a trailing P/E of 31.83. Key metrics to track include advanced node capacity expansion, gross margin trends, and key clients' AI capital expenditure.

Watch：Global macroeconomic uncertainties may impact end-market consumer electronics demand.; Geopolitical risks and initial cost pressures associated with overseas fab expansion.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，EPS 實際值 4.31 優於預期的 3.89。
